name: Angel's Love
source: In Angel's Love, the story follows Angel, a kind and principled girl, as Nyx, a lustful, depraved succubus, possesses her. Two completely different beings are forced to share one body, constantly clashing over their desires, values, and purpose. As if that weren't enough, Angel has recently been betrayed by her boyfriend, the love of her life, who abandoned her at the brink of death with cruel indifference. Now, with Nyx at her side, Angel gains both power and temptation. Together, they set out on a path of revenge, as Nyx eagerly pushes Angel to confront her past, embrace her darker impulses, and make the one who hurt her pay.
